integrity: All-dimensional claim proved analytically by sharp occupancy and parity construction. Separate source programs check 1794 equality witnesses and twice exhaustively enumerate 16777216 labelled configurations at d=3. Independent scientific review not performed.
scientific_limitations: The result assumes finite unweighted coordinate-clique cube graphs with uniform positive classical Ising coupling at zero temperature. It does not cover finite-temperature, quantum, or arbitrary-weight systems, nor general-dimension multiplicity classification. Historical priority beyond examined material remains unverified.
title: Exact magnetic-field staircases for clique-fiber hypercube antiferromagnets
